title: Boss Rush: every boss, back to back
description: A new mode next to Free Run and the Daily: the bosses of all four maps in a row with a breather and a level-up between each, its own board label and its own missions.

title: Evolve everything + a Collection
description: Part 1 of a full evolution table: every base weapon gets an evolution with its own art and effect, the level-up card says what it will become, and a Collection screen shows everything you've seen.

title: Story Mode: Chapter 1
description: Five short stages in a row, each with its own goal and a story card between them, ending in a boss fight, as a new mode beside Free Run and the Daily.
